name: Artificial Analysis launches Intelligence Index v5
title: Artificial Analysis launches Intelligence Index v5
summary: Artificial Analysis released Intelligence Index v5, adding FrontierCode 2.0 and Terminal-Bench-Science, with 60% of the score from private or held-out tests, plus Progress Index v1. At launch Claude Opus 5.5 (max) scored 58, GPT-6 Astra 57, and GPT-6.1 Sol 55, while the best released open weights, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 and GLM-5.3, scored 32.

New entries are Cognition's FrontierCode 2.0 (graded on whether a maintainer would merge the change) and Terminal-Bench-Science (70 agentic science tasks in a terminal).
